usedFor: Copper captures leads and people, and Daftra gets each “New Person” as a client through “Add Client”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Person” in Copper, then “Add Client” in Daftra
bestTemplate.why: A person added in Copper is ready as a client in Daftra before the first invoice is needed.

watchOut: “New Lead” in Copper would also run “Add Client”, so pick one trigger or unqualified leads become clients.
